ns2:section.sectionText: "UNIVERSITY OF ILLINOIS HIP HOP COLLECTIVE." Open to all instrumentalists, rappers, vocalists, DJs, emcees, beatboxers, writers, dancers, videographers, audio engineers, producers, etc. wishing to collaborate on live shows, podcasts, and videos presenting hip hop and related genres (R&B, dubstep, trip hop, trap, EDM, etc). Course features large and small ensembles, involving in-depth study of styles, extended instrumental techniques, electronic media, historical/social contexts of musical genres, and engagement with communities on and off campus (schools/artists/venues & community/campus organizations). Class times and locations to be arranged. Open with permission of instructor for all students (major, non-major, graduate, undergraduate). For course approval, students must submit an application at http://www.rudolfhaken.com/hiphop
